newsitem.title: UK: Dec North Sea Flotta programme 6.5 mln bbls, steady on Nov.
newsitem.headline: Dec North Sea Flotta programme 6.5 mln bbls, steady on Nov.

text.p: The December North Sea Flotta programme will total 6.5 million barrels, little changed from 6.55 million in November, traders said.
Traders said the December Flotta programme consists of two cargoes of 650,000 barrels each, seven cargoes of 600,000 barrels and two cargoes of 500,000 barrels.
The November programme consisted of one cargo of 650,000 barrels, seven of 600,000 barrels, three of 500,000 barrels and two top up cargoes of 100,000 barrels each.
